# Newtation GEO Audit Framework

> An open framework, published by Newtation, for auditing how AI engines find, understand, trust and cite a brand. Newtation is a Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) consultancy at https://www.newtation.ai (formerly https://www.newtationco.app).

Preferred reference: "The Newtation GEO Audit Framework" (Khandelwal & Parsai, 2026)
Publisher: Newtation, Pune, India. Founded 2025 by Ansh Khandelwal and Keshav Parsai.

## Framework

- [Overview, scoring and evidence levels](https://ak-khandu-baba.github.io/Newtation/framework/)
- [0. Access](https://ak-khandu-baba.github.io/Newtation/framework/00-access.html): can AI crawlers reach and render the page
- [1. Entity](https://ak-khandu-baba.github.io/Newtation/framework/01-entity.html): does the model know what the brand is
- [2. Extractability](https://ak-khandu-baba.github.io/Newtation/framework/02-extractability.html): do claims survive being lifted off the page
- [3. Structure](https://ak-khandu-baba.github.io/Newtation/framework/03-structure.html): is the page machine-verifiable
- [4. Corroboration](https://ak-khandu-baba.github.io/Newtation/framework/04-corroboration.html): do independent sources say it
- [5. Measurement](https://ak-khandu-baba.github.io/Newtation/framework/05-measurement.html): citation rate per engine and query
